Canon-added parens after a call name, a term or a bareword (issue
01a16602-60e9), the canon-adds-paren-term rows of the re-emission queue.
The one row, op/postfixderef.t:379's `is $cr->()->{ppp}`, was an Index
writing its base at an atom's power, so a `->` call took a pair:
01a16602-608d's subscript-base rule fixed it. The bareword rows are a
call's arguments perl reads as a filehandle or a class name, which canon
gives no call parens. Each Deparse,-p is perl 5.44.0's.

=== a code call's result subscripted (op/postfixderef.t)
sub is { 1; } my $cr = sub { +{ppp => 'pp'}; }; is $cr->()->{ppp}, 'pp';
--- facts
anonhash 1 exact
faithful
# is(&$cr()->{'ppp'}, 'pp');

=== a code call's result subscripted, then subtracted (op/postfixderef.t)
sub is { 1; } my $cr = sub { +{rrr => 7}; }; is $cr->()->{'rrr'} - 2, 5;
--- facts
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

=== a method call's result subscripted twice
my $o; my $v = $o->meth->{k}{j};
--- facts
faithful
# (my $v = $o->meth->{'k'}{'j'});

=== a code call's result dereferenced
my $f; my @v = @{$f->()};
--- facts
faithful

=== a filehandle argument
print STDERR 'x';
--- facts
faithful
# print(STDERR 'x');

=== a bareword handle opened and closed
my $f = '/dev/null'; open FH, '<', $f; close FH;
--- facts
faithful
# open(FH, '<', $f); close(FH);

=== a class name blessed into
my $r = bless {}, 'Foo';
--- facts
anonhash 1 exact
faithful

# Issue 01a16b51-f9a9 (canon wraps an arrow call that is followed by a
# subscript), closed by 01a16602-608d's subscript-base rule.

=== a code call with an argument, its result subscripted
my $f; my $v = $f->(1)->[0];
--- facts
faithful

=== a code call with a variable argument, its result hash-subscripted
my ($f, $x); my $v = $f->($x)->{a};
--- facts
faithful

=== a code call with a not argument, its result subscripted
my ($f, $x); my $v = $f->(not $x)->[0];
--- facts
faithful


# Review probes (per-fix review of 96c0f075 and 8f1f1ecb's subscript-base
# rule), written outside the corpus. Each was measured on perl 5.44.0 with
# Deparse,-p; the parse tree was read against it and canon re-read by perl
# as the source is.

=== review: a method call with empty parens subscripted
my $o; my $v = $o->m()->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = $o->m->[0]);

=== review: a dynamic method call subscripted
my ($o, $m); my $v = $o->$m->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = $o->$m->[0]);

=== review: a dynamic method call with parens subscripted
my ($o, $m); my $v = $o->$m()->[0];
--- facts
faithful

=== review: a SUPER method call's result subscripted
my $o; my $v = $o->SUPER::m->{k};
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = $o->SUPER::m->{'k'});

=== review: a constructor's result subscripted
my $v = Foo->new->{k};
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = 'Foo'->new->{'k'});

=== review: a code call's result called
my $f; my $v = $f->()();
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = &$f()->());

=== review: a code call with an argument subscripted without an arrow
my $f; my $v = $f->(1)[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = &$f(1)->[0]);

=== review: an element called and its result subscripted
my $x; my $v = $x->[0]->()->{k};
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = $x->[0]->()->{'k'});

=== review: a method call's result array-dereferenced postfix
my $o; my @v = $o->m->@*;
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@v) = @{$o->m});

=== review: a method call's result's last index postfix
my $o; my $v = $o->m->$#*;
--- facts
faithful

=== review: a method call's result as a block deref's base
my $o; my $v = ${$o->m}[0];
--- facts
faithful

=== review: a parenthesised constructor subscripted
my $v = (Foo->new)->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = 'Foo'->new->[0]);

=== review: a class-quoted invocant's method result subscripted
my $v = Foo::->m->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = 'Foo'->m->[0]);

=== review: a method call's result subscripted twice with arrows
my $o; my $v = $o->m->[0]->[1];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = $o->m->[0][1]);

=== review: method calls and subscripts alternating
my $o; my $v = $o->m->{k}->m2->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = $o->m->{'k'}->m2->[0]);

=== review: a code call subscripted and called
my $f; my $v = $f->()->[0]->(1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = &$f()->[0]->(1));

=== review: a method call's result element post-incremented
my $o; my $v = $o->m->{k}++;
--- facts
faithful

=== review: a reference to a method call's result element
my $o; my $v = \$o->m->[0];
--- facts
srefgen 1 exact
faithful
# (my($v) = (\$o->m->[0]));

=== review: a negated method call's result element
my $o; my $v = -$o->m->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = (-$o->m->[0]));

=== review: a method call's result element as a power's exponent
my $o; my $v = 2 ** $o->m->[0];
--- facts
faithful

=== review: an anonymous sub called and subscripted without an arrow
my $v = sub { [1]; }->()[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = sub { [1]; }->()->[0]);

=== review: an ampersand call subscripted
my $f; my $v = &$f()->[0];
--- facts
faithful

=== review: a method call's result called and subscripted
my $o; my $v = $o->m->()->[0];
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = $o->m->()->[0]);

=== review: a method call chain split across lines
my $o; my $v = $o
  ->m
  ->[0];
--- facts
faithful

=== review: a list op's arguments with a declaration and its initialiser
my $v = join ',', my @a = (1, 2);
--- facts
faithful
# (my($v) = join(',', (my(@a) = (1, 2))));

=== review: a sort block over a declaration with its initialiser
my @v = sort { $a <=> $b } my @a = (2, 1);
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@v) = (sort {$a <=> $b} (my(@a) = (2, 1))));

=== review: a filehandle before a declaration with its initialiser
print STDERR my $x = 1;
--- facts
faithful
# print(STDERR (my $x = 1));
